corrections.after: Replay each outer fold independently, flatten at the end of every fold, and reset portfolio state before the next fold.
corrections.before: Portfolio state was carried from one outer fold to the next.

corrections.after: Split the first 70% and last 30% chronologically inside every outer fold; fit each learned threshold or model only on that fold's selection partition; evaluate only on the same fold's tail.
corrections.before: A single global chronological 70/30 split concentrated evaluation evidence in the final outer fold and could contaminate earlier-fold decisions with later-fold information if a global threshold were fit.
